items.title: 68090_Ed Garland oral history interview
items.q: Bechet was sitting down on the tracks say, buddy, can I come over there with you? Yeah, all right with me.

ctx.x: -- and you run into it and get your legs crossed on the club, and throw you down. They throw it right between your legs, bum, down you go. Then they take the -- see on the end of it, this is rawhide. Piece of rawhide. So, put the hand on it and wrapped around in it. They used to whip you. Get a whipping with that thing. Get on out of here. Run you. Oh, Bechet come over to Bay St. Louis, used to go around in Sundays -- excursion all day. And we used to go that there mandolin and guitar and bass, you know --

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: We was over in Bass St. Louis with Madeline and guitar. Bass. And Bassier was sitting out there on the trunces, you know. And we happened to come out.

ctx.x: Yeah. No, they didn't have no cotton. They were friends, huh?

They were friends. Bassier, this guy went there and blowed. And could blow. We was over in Bass St. Louis with Madeline and guitar. Bass. And Bassier was sitting out there on the trunces, you know. And we happened to come out. And that's what he was doing there, he said. Suck down, he just come on over on excursion. So, he said, got your clint in? He said, no, I ain't got no horn. So, there was an old man there. He said, what did he play? I said, he plays a clint in. Know anybody around here that got a clint in?…

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: I went and got Basie. I stole Basie and bought Basie up to the Deluxe side to do it.

ctx.x: Oh, I stayed, I stayed, I stayed in the Deluxe three, four years or more. Then, two years and something. Because Billy Bottoms got me to come over to Dreamland, see. Just before I went to the Dreamland, uh, Basie come to Chicago with, uh, P.R. this woman who called, oh, it was already a TV time, uh, show, what's that called? Come there with a show and a heart, and I went and got Basie. I stole Basie and bought Basie up to the Deluxe side to do it.
